text:
nora: Heads-up: new CLI quickstart spawns 50 parallel workers and onboarders are hitting 429s on Hosted when they run the `bootstrap --fast` path. Repro: `seq 1 50 | xargs -P50 -I% ./sample-cli generate --prompt hi`

nora: server headers show `x-rw-rate-limit=30`, `x-rw-rate-remaining=0`, `x-rw-quota-reset=6s`. Body: {"error":"quota_exceeded"}.

devon: which SDK backing the CLI? Rust SDK or raw HTTP?

nora: Rust SDK v0.1.0 currently. It implements a simple token-bucket inclient but it doesn't read rate headers or shrink window on 429. Default bucket size=64.

leyla: parity note: JS and Go SDKs already have header-aware governors that honor x-rw-rate-remaining. Rust missing that adapter — filed GH #303.

matt: also noticed CLI `--fast` increases prefetch and batch sizes which amplifies bursts. Quick mitigation: change CLI default to `--concurrency 8` and set client token-bucket to `burst=8` for quickstart.

devon: we should implement adaptive token-bucket: on each response read `x-rw-rate-limit`/`x-rw-rate-remaining` and scale available permits to remaining (with a tiny buffer). On 429, reduce burst cap exponentially and schedule gradual recovery using quota-reset header.

leyla: agreed. Also add a singleflight token refresh for Rust SDK; we saw thundering-herd issues in other SDKs. I'll own #303. ETA today for header-aware governor and singleflight.

nora: quick local patch: `bucket.SetBurst(8); bucket.EnableHeaderAware(true)` + backoff jitter (rand between 200-800ms base) -> manual run of the CLI with 50 workers -> no 429s after 5m. Latency slightly up but acceptable for onboarding.

matt: let's update quickstart docs and CLI README to recommend `--concurrency` and show snippet: `RW_MAX_CONCURRENCY=8 sample-cli bootstrap --concurrency 8`. Also add note: "If you see persistent 429s, lower concurrency or enable header-aware governor."

rust-sdk-bot: `cargo test --test backpressure -- --nocapture` -> ok (5 tests, 0 failures).

ci-runner: ran staging soak: CLI quickstart (concurrency=8, header-aware=true) -> rate_limit_errors=0 for 30m.

ops-alert: FYI ops observed cross-tenant quota spikes yesterday; adaptive client should avoid hammering shared pools during mass onboarding.

leyla: I'll open PR to Rust SDK with: 1) header-aware token bucket, 2) singleflight refresh, 3) jittered exponential backoff on 429, 4) opt-in smaller onboarding defaults. PR #304 -> awaiting review.

nora: thanks. I'll update sample-cli repo and onboarding guide. PR for docs ready.

matt: once merged, coordinate a small blog post about "Onboarding safely: client-side backpressure patterns" for devx readers.

devon: follow-up: add a unit test simulating `x-rw-quota-reset` bumps so we can validate recovery window.

leyla: added test case in PR. ci-runner: pending.

nora: moving board card to in-progress. Will monitor telemetry after deploy. :rocket:
